name: Chapter tag
oneLiner: agenda: a glass panel (a soft side scrim as B-roll) where 3 to 5 chapters type in one per beat down a lit track, then a highlight slides onto the current one; tag mode: the small persistent corner pill with the chapter number, its name and a progress strip
say: agenda when the speaker lays out what the video covers ('I'll show you the tools, the setup, my style and the exact cost'): one item per spoken chapter; re-render at each chapter start with current set to it. mode tag: drop it top-right for the length of a section (set duration to the section length)
